title: Qutrit Magic State Distillation: From Codes over GF(9) to Fault-Tolerant Thresholds
excerpt: A walkthrough of the qutrit stabiliser formalism, self-dual additive codes over GF(9), and how we searched for distillation routines with thresholds exceeding prior art — the research behind arXiv:2408.00436.

title: From Research to Patent: Conflict-Free Graph Coloring and My Springer Publication
excerpt: How I designed a novel heuristic for estimating two-colorability for conflict-free coloring in simple graphs, got it published in Springer AISC, and obtained Australian patent 2021104261.

title: Building 200K-events/day Infrastructure at Amazon Delivery
excerpt: How we architected the Background Check Transparency Platform at Amazon Delivery — AWS Lambda, SNS/SQS, DynamoDB Streams, and a cluster-based ETA prediction engine — processing 200K+ daily vendor events with full fault tolerance.

title: Real-Time Signal Visualisation with D3.js and Angular at Keysight
excerpt: How I built interactive real-time charts for digitised DMM and oscilloscope signals at Keysight Technologies — integrating SCPI remote commands with an Angular + D3.js frontend and multithreaded C++ backend.

title: Understanding Complex Networks through Graphlet Analysis — MITACS Internship
excerpt: My MITACS Globalink research experience at the University of Northern British Columbia — designing efficient algorithms for graphlet and orbit enumeration, and applying them to real-world network data under Prof. Alex Aravind.

title: Winning Quantum Hackathons: IBM Challenge, iQuHACK MIT, and Quantum Winter Hackathon
excerpt: A reflection on my journey through quantum hackathons — from securing first place in Quantum Winter Hackathon 2020 and rank 183 globally in IBM Quantum Challenge 2020, to receiving a Certificate of Recognition at MIT's iQuHACK 2021.
